requires: Fresh current authenticated principal and identity revision, compared by Meri with the verified identity snapshot
Online/current native-session revocation checked through established Clerk backend session owner; verifyToken alone is insufficient; exact API establishment remains Capiro-owned
Existing active conversation owner predicate including tenant, user, archivedAt null and Research Portfolio authorization

Existing nonarchived client visibility and current ContextSecurityScopeService selected-client ethical-wall authorization

wireRules.ids: UUID identities normalized consistently with existing database identities; no alias or latest-row fallback
wireRules.identitySha256: Lowercase SHA-256 correlation value supplied by Meri; an echoed hash is not authentication
wireRules.revisions: Nonempty bounded opaque server-authored stable security-state revisions: native session identity, principal, membership role/status/version and applicable context policy facts. Exclude checkedAt/lastSeen/lastActive/unrelated activity timestamps. Exact derivation requires Capiro owner implementation/tests.
wireRules.times: Safe integer epoch milliseconds; checkedAtMs sampled after checks; expiry is bounded by original verified JWT/session and applicable authority expiry, never locally refreshed.
wireRules.secrets: No raw token, user email, profile, conversation content, mailbox credential, JWT claims body or private metadata in response
wireRules.cache: No-store; no successful fallback on verification/policy/timeout failure

meriJoin.requiredOwner: Existing injected currentRun(binding,{signal}) canonical port, supplied by an authoritative admitted-run implementation
meriJoin.scopeOwner: Meri trusted host commandContext and policy scopes, freshly corroborated by currentRun and existing business/source authority; not Capiro echo
